steps.clue: Activate the Sentinel Artifact, obtain the Golden Bridle and ride Pegasus to Dark Delphi.
Free the two caged eagles and defend the Center of the World.
Reignite the Eternal Flame and light the three oil spills with Apollo’s Will.
Use the Redeemed Hand of Charon to destroy the four glowing statues.
Repair the hidden cogs with Apollo’s Will and turn the statues inward.
Complete the Ra and Danu challenges, recover Ra’s Scepter and solve the sundial.
Complete the Amphitheater shooting gallery using the Hands of God.
Enter the symbols on the door at the River of Sorrow.
Use the Pegasus Strike to summon the Ballista.
Aim the Ballista with Ouranos and poison Apollo’s Will to fire it at the Python.
Enter the portal and defeat Pegasus and Perseus.
